decision.justification: CWT_catboost is the champion on both trend (slope_agreement 0.93) and seasonality (residual_corr 0.67), and the ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.10, no model is always top-3). In this regime, a single model that captures both components cleanly outperforms any pool, because the other models' errors are not complementary but rather window-specific noise. The separated margin (0.70) over the next-best strategy confirms the gap is real, not sampling noise.
